plan: With a private value of $15, I want to bid strategically. Since this is a single round, I'll aim to bid just above what I expect other rational bidders might choose. My goal is to win if the potential profit justifies the bid. Given the value range of $0-$49, a mid-range strategy around my value makes sense. I'll bid slightly above my value to signal serious intent but not overcommit.

With a private value of $36, I want to maximize potential profit. Since this is a single round, I'll use a strategic bid that balances winning probability with profit margin. Other rational bidders will likely bid below their full value. I'll aim to bid slightly above the midpoint of my value, around $25-$30, to increase my chances of winning while preserving potential profit. This approach considers that other bidders are also trying to optimize their strategy.
